capabilities: Create a card from selected text via context menu or command
Store cards as Markdown files in a cards folder with review-tracking frontmatter
Browse cards one at a time in a card view with navigation and source-note links
Review cards by writing recalled answers from memory and comparing against the original
Schedule follow-up reviews at 2, 4, 7 and 12 day intervals with pass/fail self-grading
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) with slightly more detail in the Chinese text; installation requires building from source or manual copying, no community plugin store install is described. Cards are styled after Claude's card design.
motivation: The README frames the goal as using active recall plus spaced review to fight forgetting ("通过主动回忆 + 间隔复习对抗遗忘").
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note selections into flashcards and schedule active-recall reviews of them.
summary: Flashcard plugin that turns selected text into styled cards and reviews them through active recall with a fixed spaced-repetition schedule (2/4/7/12 days).
